hypothesis: When the question's requested attribute/value is explicitly present in visible evidence, one answer action should return that requested value concisely rather than a related entity or partial value.

evaluation_design.comparison: same 16 frozen evidence-answer prompts on the fixed v118 adapter and the single SFT adapter
evaluation_design.primary_metric: SQuAD-normalized exact match, paired case table
evaluation_design.review_changed_answers: blinded evidence support review before any positive claim
evaluation_design.promotion_rule: exploratory only; continue consideration only if at least +2/16 exact matches with no confirmed evidence-support regression; otherwise stop
evaluation_design.scope_caveat: This tests answer extraction with official supporting evidence supplied. It is not an end-to-end search result or a generalization claim.

review_policy: All 25 training answers reuse previously validated DeepSeek+Luna approvals and primary retention; no new review calls. Dev labels come from official source answers and exact source supporting facts; dev labels are never used as training labels.
new_pool_disposition: The 32 unreviewed training candidates and 16 unreviewed reserves are not used; the prepared 48-item review packet is superseded and was never sent. Only the 16 precommitted dev items are used from the new pool.
